debit.sms: SMS BLOCK<space>HSBC<space><last four digits of your card number> to 575750 from your registered mobile number
debit.notes: PhoneBanking 1800 267 3456 / 1800 121 2208 is toll-free within India (6.30am to 8.30pm IST, 7 days a week); emergency services - reporting unauthorised transactions, blocking or cancelling your card - are available 24/7 on the same lines. From outside India: +91-40-65118002 / +91-22-71728002 (HSBC Premier customers: 1800 266 3456 / 1800 120 4722, 24/7, overseas +91-40-65118001 / +91-22-71728001). SMS block from your registered mobile number: SMS BLOCK<space>HSBC<space><last four digits of your card number> to 575750. Mobile app: on the HSBC India Mobile Banking app, 'If your card is lost or stolen you can temporarily block it - and unblock it if you find it' (app downloaded from Play Store on Android and App Store on iOS per the bank's own app page). Log on to online banking at https://www.hsbc.bank.in; no public email for block requests (the bank directs written contact to secure messages in online banking: 'Help & support' > 'Secure messages').

credit.notes: PhoneBanking 1800 267 3456 / 1800 121 2208 is toll-free within India (6.30am to 8.30pm IST, 7 days a week); emergency services - reporting unauthorised transactions, blocking or cancelling your card - are available 24/7 on the same lines. From outside India: +91-40-65118002 / +91-22-71728002 (HSBC Premier customers: 1800 266 3456 / 1800 120 4722, 24/7, overseas +91-40-65118001 / +91-22-71728001). Credit card Key Fact Statement: in case of a lost or stolen credit card, report immediately in writing, by PhoneBanking, or by sending an SMS with 'BLOCK' to 575750. Credit card FAQ: report the loss to HSBC PhoneBanking or to the Visa Global Emergency Assistance Helplines immediately; request replacement at PhoneBanking/Branch/Internet Banking; confirm the loss in writing to The Manager, Credit Cards, Post Box Number 5080, Chennai - 600 028. Mobile app: on the HSBC India Mobile Banking app you can temporarily block a lost/stolen card and unblock it if found. Log on to online banking at https://www.hsbc.bank.in; no public email for block requests (secure messages in online banking only).

upi.notes: HSBC's UPI app is HSBC SimplyPay - download only from the certified Google Play / Apple App Store links above (FAQ: 'Customers should download the HSBC SimplyPay App from certified Apple App store and Google play store'). If a VPA is compromised, per the SimplyPay FAQ you can block the VPA by contacting HSBC Phonebanking: Premier - 1800 266 3456 & 1800 120 4722; Advance & Personal Banking - 1800 267 3456 & 1800 121 2208 (from overseas +91-40-65118002 & +91-22-71728002). Self-service: de-register your VPA from HSBC SimplyPay by navigating to the 'Deregister' tab under 'Manage Account' on the UPI App. Blocking vs de-registering (FAQ wording): blocking keeps you a valid user of HSBC SimplyPay but 'your transactions - pay, collect or balance enquiry would be blocked'; de-registering 'means deleting the entire VPA and Mobile number record' and 'the said VPA will not be available for a period of 2 years from the date of de-registration'; de-registration is not allowed while UPI mandates are active. UPI PIN compromised: change it via the 'change UPI PIN' tab on the app. SimplyPay issues: call the Phone Banking numbers above. No netbanking UPI manage path, no SMS keyword and no *99# channel published on HSBC India pages (bank site search checked 2026-11-01).
